purpose: Verify the documentary identity of Quebrada Dos Barrios (Rímac corridor, Chosica) on archived sources and register it as IDENTITY_ONLY. No geometry, confluence, outlet or event is derived.

labels_in_sources: quebradas La Ronda, Dos Barrios, Santo Domingo

attestations.reading: SENAMHI names 'Dos Barrios' among the quebradas contiguous to the quebrada Santo Domingo.
The thesis lists 'Dos Barrios' among left-bank Rímac quebradas with flows in April 2012 (list level).

identity_basis.independence: Two documents by different authors and institutions (SENAMHI 2020; UPM thesis 2018). Whether they share an underlying source is not established.
identity_basis.sufficient_for: IDENTITY_ONLY documentary row. Not sufficient for hydrologic distinctness, geometry, confluence or any event attribution.

candidate.administrative_basis: Not stated for Dos Barrios by any source read. SENAMHI places the study area in the middle Rímac basin at Chosica; the neighbouring quebrada La Ronda is recorded in Lurigancho-Chosica by the national audit and in Ricardo Palma by IGP 2020 (quote IGP-P16-LA-RONDA-DISTRICT), so no district is inferred from adjacency.

documentary_location.reading: Contiguous to the quebrada Santo Domingo; '(al este)' follows 'Dos Barrios y La Ronda' and its scope (both or only La Ronda) is not adjudicated.
Named in a list of quebradas 'de la margen izquierda del río Rímac' (list-level statement).

historical_period_mentions.note: Not an event record for this unit. The contemporary RIIGEO 2012 article on the 5 April 2012 flows lists the left-bank quebradas La Cantuta, Santo Domingo, Mariscal Castilla, La Ronda and California and does not name Dos Barrios (quote RII-P7-LEFT-BANK-LIST).

relations_recorded_not_adopted.note: Similar 'Dos …' labels, both listed for the April 2012 flows by different documents (thesis; PREDES booklet). No source equates them; they are not merged.
Adjacency stated in text only; no shared divide, confluence or catchment boundary is derived.

documents_checked_without_the_label.note: Contemporary account of the 5 April 2012 flows; Dos Barrios not named.
IGP 2020 report on La Ronda and other quebradas; Dos Barrios not named.
ANA faja marginal study of Santo Domingo; Dos Barrios not named.

documents_checked_without_the_label.rule: Absence from a document is not evidence that the quebrada does not exist.

blockers: District and province: not stated for Dos Barrios by any source read.
